method: For each of the 27 companies, fetched ARES's base economic-subject endpoint (ekonomicke-subjekty) for czNace codes and judged the assigned SECTOR_OVERRIDES bucket against them; for the 8 MUNICIPAL_SOE_EXPLICIT entries plus one override entry that raised an ownership question (EAST BOHEMIAN AIRPORT), additionally fetched ARES's VR endpoint (ekonomicke-subjekty-vr) for the current (non-datumVymazu) akcionar records, falling back to the company's own site / press (Wikipedia, epravo.cz) when ARES VR carries no shareholder record because there is more than one shareholder (VR lists an a.s. shareholder only when there is exactly one). SOMPO's ownership was not re-fetched — batch-010 already established and cited it (ARES VR + sompo.cz) and this audit only re-confirms its verdict is still CONFIRMED under the current list placement.

companies.label: ČEPRO, a.s.
companies.ownership: Sole current shareholder is Česká republika - Ministerstvo financí ČR (Czech state, Ministry of Finance) per the current (non-lapsed) akcionar record; previously the state Fond národního majetku ČR until 2006.

companies.label: Pražská energetika, a.s.
companies.ownership: PRE has more than one shareholder, so ARES VR carries no individual akcionar record (VR lists an a.s. shareholder only when there is exactly one). Per Wikipedia (citing PRE/press reporting): Pražská energetika Holding, a.s. holds 58.05% of PRE directly, and Hlavní město Praha (City of Prague) has been the Holding's majority shareholder (51%) since the Holding's 2000 founding, with EnBW (Germany) holding the remainder; Prague also controls board appointments via a shareholder agreement with EnBW. Effective indirect Prague economic stake (~58%x51%=~30%) is below outright majority, but the controlling direct shareholder of PRE (the Holding) is itself Prague-majority-owned and Prague holds governance control — the same municipal-control pattern the list already applies to SOMPO's indirect municipal-association ownership.

companies.label: EAST BOHEMIAN AIRPORT a.s.
companies.ownership: ARES VR carries no individual akcionar record (more than one shareholder). Per epravo.cz reporting on the city's 2010s buyout of the remaining private stake, the Pardubice airport operator is now wholly publicly owned: 66% by the Statutární město Pardubice (City of Pardubice) and 34% by the Pardubický kraj (Pardubice Region) — no private shareholder remains.
companies.correction: The sector bucket ('transport') is correct, but the LIST is wrong: the company is 100% owned by the City of Pardubice (66%) and the Pardubice Region (34%) — a municipality/kraj majority ownership, exactly MUNICIPAL_SOE_EXPLICIT's criterion. It should move from SECTOR_OVERRIDES to MUNICIPAL_SOE_EXPLICIT so a board seat here is excluded from the sector-adjacency conflict signal, the same reasoning already applied to ČEPRO/MERO/Pražská energetika/Kongresové centrum Praha.

companies.ownership: Not investigated (private medical practice — out of scope). NACE 86210/86220 (general and specialist medical practice) directly supports 'health'.

companies.label: SynBiol, a.s.
companies.ownership: Private — spun off from AGROFERT's 2013 split; a holding company (NACE 64210) within the SynBiol/AGROFERT structure, previously Andrej Babiš's personal holding vehicle, now in trust funds. Ownership is not what's wrong here — the sector is.
companies.correction: SynBiol is bucketed 'health' (comment: 'biotech') but carries NO health/medical NACE code (no 86xxx). Its own site describes its actual business as manufacturing and processing fuels and lubricants and production/sale of hazardous and toxic chemical substances (matching NACE 205/20599/20130 — manufacture of other basic/other chemical products). Despite the 'bio'-sounding name, this is a chemicals company, not a health/biotech one. It should move to 'environment', the bucket this list already uses for every other AGROFERT-family chemicals company (Synthesia, Fatra, PRECHEZA, SPOLANA, CS CABOT).
